> **Never paste your passphrase, a recovery code, a device key or the contents of your journal into an
> issue.** If you think you have found a security vulnerability, do not open an issue: follow the
> [security policy](https://github.com/pocket-nutrition/vault-web/security/policy) instead.

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what is wrong.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the page at ...
2. Log in with ...
3. Click on ...
4. See the error

If you can, reproduce it with a test account rather than your own vault.

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen instead, and why.

## What the page showed

The exact message on the page, and any errors in the browser console (developer tools, Console tab).
Remove anything personal before pasting.

## Environment

- Where you ran it: the official page, the container image (give the tag, for example `2026.11.1`), or a build from source (`git rev-parse HEAD`)
- Browser and version:
- Operating system:
- Two-factor login on for the account: yes / no
- Daily targets set up in the app (only matters for the Targets tab): yes / no
- Vault you logged in to: the official one, or your own (which version)

## Additional context

Add any other context about the problem here. Remove anything personal first.
